full-suite-on-subagent-stop.mjs.reason: Still not adopted, re-checked 14 August 2026 against the current template. The per-edit / end-of-task split exists to keep a large slow suite off every single edit. This suite is 240 tests in about a third of a second, so running it on every edit costs nothing worth optimising, and the split would add a moving part with no benefit. Revisit if this suite ever grows slow enough that an edit-time run is felt.

full-suite-on-subagent-stop.test.ts.reason: Still not adopted, re-checked 14 August 2026. This tests a hook this project deliberately does not have; see the reason recorded for full-suite-on-subagent-stop.mjs. Adopting the test without the hook it covers would be a test of nothing.

suite-stamp.mjs.reason: Only the end-of-task hook needs the stamp, and this project deliberately runs the whole suite on every edit instead. Nothing here would read it.

suite-stamp.test.ts.reason: Tests a hook this project deliberately does not have. See the reason recorded for suite-stamp.mjs.

run-tests-unless-docs.test.ts.reason: This project has its own equivalent at .claude/hooks/run-tests-unless-docs.test.js, written in JS against this project's own adapted hook. The template's version is TypeScript and covers the split this project did not adopt.

protect-paths.mjs.reason: Same guard, reduced. The template also blocks Prisma migration edits; this project has no database, so a rule that can never fire was dropped rather than carried as noise.

run-tests-unless-docs.mjs.reason: Runs 'npm test' rather than the runner directly, so the hook and the command a human would type cannot disagree, and exits 2 rather than propagating the runner's exit 1, which is the only code Claude Code feeds back to the agent. Also lacks the split this project did not adopt.

project-root.mjs.reason: Logic is byte-identical to the template; verified by diff on 13 August 2026. Only the comments differ, recording the cases measured in this project rather than the ones measured in interplanetary-groups.

protect-paths.test.ts.reason: Adopted on 14 August 2026, but as protect-paths.test.js rather than .ts, because this project is plain JavaScript and has no TypeScript anywhere; a single .ts file would be the only one in the repo. The content is the template's, with every Prisma migration case dropped (this project has no database, and the hook itself drops that half for the same reason) and the stderr assertions retargeted at this project's wording. 18 tests, both directions, and both directions were seen failing against a deliberately broken guard before being committed. This line is recorded rather than left reporting because the report says the project has no test for its env guard, which is no longer true.

$comment: Differences from ~/.claude/templates/project-safety-nets/ that this project has deliberately accepted. Written by `node ~/.claude/bin/accept-safety-net-difference.mjs`, read by ~/.claude/hooks/safety-net-drift.mjs. Each entry is pinned to the template file it was accepted against: when that template file changes, the acceptance expires and the difference is reported again.
